tools.description: Describe one recipe: versions, variants, and description. Probes `spack info` first; if that subcommand is unavailable or fails on this deployment, falls back to statically parsing the recipe's package.py and marks the result degraded=true with degraded_reason explaining why -- never silently. A package absent from every registered repo returns the structured recipe_not_found error.

tools.description: Resolve one unique installed Spack spec. Copy spack_locate.output.load_spec unchanged into one element of jarvis_run.input.spack_specs; do not derive or pass an executable path from the returned prefix. An absent package returns the structured not_installed error, whose detail now says whether a recipe is available to install (through a jarvis install job) or exists in no registered repo at all.

load_spec.description: Exact runtime identity for JARVIS. Copy this value unchanged from spack_locate.output.load_spec into one element of jarvis_run.input.spack_specs.

tools.title: Locate Package

tools.description: Set up a CLIO Spack on a clio-relay site that reuses what the site already has. It shallow-clones the Spack release the site runs (pinned by commit) into <site_home>/spack, points upstreams.yaml at the site install tree, runs compiler find, registers build tools with external find --not-buildable, sets packages:mpi:buildable:false, records module-only MPIs as candidate externals and writes packages:all:compiler with full toolchains (cc, cxx, fc) first, the upstream MPI's compiler ahead, plus build_jobs. When several full toolchains qualify, report.compiler.choice_needed asks the person once. MPI is never externalized from PATH. Config lives in the checkout and SPACK_DISABLE_LOCAL_CONFIG keeps ~/.spack out. Idempotent; it never installs, builds or installs jarvis-cd. The first call returns the relay exec call (with a spack plan that a guarded relay site asks the person to approve) and the approval text; the second, with relay_result, returns the report, including the JARVIS_SPACK_ROOT and JARVIS_SPACK_CONFIG to export. needs_approval means retry the same exec once the person answers; declined means stop.

build_jobs.description: config:build_jobs; default every CPU the install job may use (Spack takes min(build_jobs, available CPUs)).

build_tools.description: Build tools for external find; default a fixed list, never MPI.

compiler.description: Compiler to put first in packages:all:compiler, such as gcc@11.4.0: the person's choice when report.compiler.choice_needed, or the fix for a build that failed in a compiler check. auto drops an earlier choice. Default: full toolchains (cc, cxx, fc) first, the upstream MPI's compiler ahead.

module_paths.description: Module directories to scan for MPIs; default MODULEPATH.

relay_result.description: Leave empty on the first call. On the second call, pass the structured result of the clio-relay exec call this tool returned.

root.description: The CLIO Spack checkout; default <site_home>/spack. On a guarded relay site queries run only the Spack its guard lists (default .clio-relay/spack/bin/spack).

site.description: The clio-relay site id, such as ares

site_home.description: The site's CLIO home: clio-relay's remote_dir for the site.

site_install_tree.description: The site install tree; default asks the site Spack.

site_spack.description: The site's own Spack root, such as /mnt/repo/software/spack/spack. Empty when the site has no Spack; then give spack_version.

spack_version.description: Spack release to clone; default the site Spack's release.

build_jobs.description: config:build_jobs in the CLIO Spack. Spack builds with min(build_jobs, CPUs the job may use); 1024 means every CPU the job was given.

compiler.description: The compiler preference written as packages:all:compiler (Spack 0.23 semantics).

choice_needed.description: More than one full toolchain qualifies. Ask the person once to pick from candidates, then prepare again with compiler set.

chosen.description: First in packages:all:compiler; the solver prefers it.

source.description: person: the compiler input; person_earlier: an earlier compiler input; upstream_mpi: the only full toolchain an installed MPI was built with; only_full_toolchain: the only one with cc, cxx and fc; default: several qualify (ask the person); no_full_toolchain: nothing has Fortran.

built_upstream_mpi.description: An installed MPI was built with it.

full.description: cc, cxx and fc are all set.

jarvis.description: What jarvis-cd must be told so its install jobs use the CLIO Spack.

environment.description: Export these into jarvis install and run jobs on the site. JARVIS_SPACK_ROOT selects the CLIO Spack; JARVIS_SPACK_CONFIG makes jarvis set SPACK_USER_CONFIG_PATH to it and SPACK_DISABLE_LOCAL_CONFIG=1, so ~/.spack is never read.

mpi_module_candidates.description: Module-only MPIs, recorded as non-default externals so jarvis can offer them as a choice. Never chosen without the person.

tools.description: Search recipe AVAILABILITY across every registered Spack repo -- broader than spack_find/spack_locate, which only see what is already installed. Answers 'does a recipe exist', 'in which repo', and 'is it already installed' in one call. No matches is a successful result with count=0.
tools.name: spack_search

outputSchema.description: Recipe availability across every registered repo, not just installs.

installed_state_degraded.description: True when `spack find` failed while resolving install state; recipe availability above is still authoritative, but every match's installed/installed_packages defaults to not-installed rather than a confirmed answer.

items.description: One catalog recipe matched by a search query.
Stable summary of one concrete installed Spack package.

repos.description: Registered repo namespaces that declare this recipe.

repos_unreadable.description: Registered repos whose package directory could not be scanned (missing path, permission denied, ...); recipes may exist there that this search could not see. Never treat an empty result as a confirmed absence when this list is non-empty.

total_matches.description: Total ranked matches before the response cap; compare with count/truncated to tell '25 of 25' from '25 of 60'.

truncated.description: True when total_matches exceeds the 25-result cap.

tools.title: Search Recipes

tools.description: Research a clio-relay site's CLIO Spack (prepared by spack_prepare_site): find (installed and upstream packages, --json), info (one recipe), spec (spack spec -I -l: what is installed, upstream, external or still to build) or modules (module -t avail). Read-only, short login-node work; Spack runs as env SPACK_DISABLE_LOCAL_CONFIG=1 <spack> <verb>, the shape clio-relay's guard accepts. The first call returns the relay exec call; the second, with relay_result, returns the parsed answer.
